item.title: CVE-2020-13654 - My First CVE: XSS > CSRF > Privesc to ADMIN
item.description: How I discovered a Stored XSS in XWiki Platform < 12.8, why the HttpOnly flag prevented cookie theft, and how I had to pivot the attack toward a privilege escalation via CSRF, ultimately earning my first CVE from MITRE.
